suite.title: ConfigReach external holdout validation
suite.selection_policy: Predetermined cross-ecosystem holdout selected before ConfigReach results were examined. Projects must not overlap validation/real_world_projects.json, are pinned to immutable full commit SHAs, and are retained regardless of observed ConfigReach coverage.

profiles.smoke: Fast representative subset for pull requests and pushes.
profiles.full: All frozen holdout projects for scheduled and manual validation.

projects.rationale: Large configuration-heavy orchestration application with extensive Python and deployment configuration.
Modern Python settings-heavy application and workflow platform.
Large JavaScript/TypeScript framework with environment-driven build and runtime behavior.
Representative JavaScript/TypeScript toolchain with dotenv and environment-variable semantics.
Go application with Kubernetes, YAML and deployment-oriented configuration.
Direct stress test of Spring configuration-property and Java environment support.
Large .NET codebase for IConfiguration, environment-variable and feature-management patterns.
Production Rust codebase with environment-driven CLI and tool behavior.
Mature Ruby framework exercising ENV access patterns and framework configuration.
Mature PHP framework with common env(...) and configuration-file patterns.
Focused Terraform module with variables, defaults and validation constraints.
